notes: - The canvas now lays every card on its own colour: A picked background used to reach the page and the surface but left the card ramp as a set of RGB blends toward white or black. RGB has no idea which direction is perceptually lighter, so a saturated canvas desaturated unevenly and a mid-tone could put two containers on nearly the same luminance while a third jumped. The canvas now generates its neutral ramp in HCT, keeps a bounded amount of its own chroma, and samples neighbouring tones for the containers, dim and bright surfaces, variant surface and inverse pair. Borders move with it, so a red canvas no longer wears the brand navy's outline. Foregrounds are chosen by measured contrast rather than a fixed light/dark threshold, which keeps AA on canvases from pure black to a mid grey.
